answer: Copying the same citations across 101 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 101 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the nectar index resolves every citation against the juniper checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the haven audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1096 identities would post 4326 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
